program.name: Side and Back Pilates
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: Long Pilates for the sides and the back: side series one day, back extension the next.
program.about: The parts of Pilates that a quick session skips. One day is the side-lying series, side bends, mermaid and inner-thigh lifts; the other is back extension, swan, swimming and breast stroke, with glute work after. They alternate. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
program.split: Sides & inner thighs / back extension & glutes
